title: StudioArtifactEnvelope
description: Story artifact envelope as persisted and exposed by /api/v3/studio. Field set follows the frozen studio_contract_v0.1/artifact_envelope.json. Canonical hash input is versioned canonical JSON of artifact content plus its schema discriminator; envelope timestamps, provider usage, and storage location do not change the content hash. Server artifacts are canonical; client drafts are clearly local and cannot overwrite locked server state.

artifact_type.description: Stable discriminator frozen in studio_contract_v0.1/artifact_envelope.json. The envelope contract is forward-compatible: new artifact types must not break envelope validation. Consumers that do not recognize a discriminator must render an unsupported-version state, not a blank screen. Known types: CreativeBrief, IdeaCandidateSet, SelectedIdea, StoryBible, WorldBible, CharacterCanon, BeatSheet, EpisodeOutline, ScreenplayDraft, ReviewReport, RevisionProposal, LockedScreenplayReceipt, LockedScreenplayPackage.

content_hash.description: Canonical content hash; immutable per content.

input_artifact_refs.description: Upstream artifact ids this artifact was derived from.

content.description: Validated artifact content conforming to its schema discriminator.
